name: Story: SARO, five in the morning (SC11)
notes: STORY steg 6, the morning act (Content/Director/Story/acts.json, act morning: from 04:00 once night_room6 has set room6_done). The old SC11 'SARO is searched' (S47SC11, PRODUKSJON_SC01_SC13.md SC11) on Freeform's own station: back at SARO on foot, then inside the building, before the telex (morning_telex). Left out: tearing the receiver's original off the event log and taking the event sheet from the desk (the old chapter's own pick-ups; Freeform's printer and logbook are the operator's, and a new pick-up would be a new mechanic). beats.text: SARO, five in the morning. Every window dark but yours.
Inside, to the control room. The remote sheets print on the telex at 05:04.
